title: Distributionally Robust PCA with Data-Adaptive Wasserstein Geometry
summary: We develop a distributionally robust formulation of principal component analysis that minimizes worst-case reconstruction risk over distributions lying within a Wasserstein neighborhood of the empirical measure. The Wasserstein neighborhood, viewed as an ambiguity set of distributions, is adaptively calibrated through a transport matrix $G$ to capture heterogeneous uncertainty across dimensions.
